hero.headline: Your Style Story Begins at HairFlix
hero.subheadline: Nestled in the heart of Gota's vibrant University Road, HairFlix Unisex Salon transforms your vision into stunning reality. Where creativity meets craftsmanship, every cut tells your unique story.

about.title: Crafting Beauty Stories Since Day One
about.story: From our elegant studio on First Floor 108, HairFlix has become Gota's trusted destination for hair transformation. We believe every person deserves to feel radiant, whether you're heading to Silver Oak College or stepping into your next chapter. Our skilled artisans blend timeless techniques with contemporary trends, creating looks that reflect your authentic self while honoring your lifestyle.

items.question: How do I book an appointment at HairFlix?
items.answer: Simply call us at 093768 07777 or visit us at First Floor 108 in Rudram SkyVue. We recommend booking in advance to secure your preferred time slot.

items.question: Do you cater to both men and women?
items.answer: Absolutely! HairFlix is a unisex salon with experienced stylists trained in cutting and styling for all genders, ages, and hair types.

items.question: Where exactly are you located in Gota?
items.answer: We're on First Floor 108 of Rudram SkyVue on University Road, directly opposite Lambda Research. Very convenient for Silver Oak College students and nearby residents.

items.question: What should I expect during my first visit?
items.answer: Your stylist will begin with a detailed consultation to understand your lifestyle, preferences, and hair goals before recommending the perfect cut or treatment for you.

items.question: Do you use professional hair products?
items.answer: Yes, we exclusively use salon-grade products and tools to ensure the best results and maintain the health of your hair during every service.

items.question: How long do typical appointments take?
items.answer: Cut and style appointments typically take 45-90 minutes, while color services may require 2-3 hours. We'll give you an accurate time estimate when you book.
